children: Apnimed, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $12.08M, a net income of $125.94M and diluted earnings per share of $3.91, compared with revenue of $17.11M, a net loss of $(69.47)M and diluted loss per share of $(14.61) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue was $12.08M for Q2 2026, down from $17.11M in Q2 2025; YoY change (29%).
Net income was $125.94M for Q2 2026, versus a net loss of $(69.47)M in Q2 2025.
Diluted EPS was $3.91 for Q2 2026, versus $(14.61) in Q2 2025.

Regulatory milestone: The NDA for Oxnimbi was submitted in April 2026 and accepted in July 2026, with a PDUFA date set for Feb. 28, 2027, positioning the company for a potential commercial launch in 2027.
Revenue shift: Related‑party R&D revenue rose sharply after an accounting change for SASS MIPA, with $96.9M recognized in H1 2026 versus $20.2M in the prior year.
Clinical progress and safety: Phase 3 LunAIRo and SynAIRgy trials met primary and key secondary endpoints with favorable tolerability across roughly 1,300 patients.
Commercial readiness: The company increased commercial marketing and medical affairs spending in H1 2026 to prepare for a potential Oxnimbi launch.
Strategic portfolio move: Apnimed divested SASS to Shionogi in April 2026 for $100M upfront while retaining royalty and earnout rights to focus resources on Oxnimbi.
